imports.title: Import requests
imports.intro: Tell us what you need and we will try to bring it in.
imports.link: A link, if you have one
imports.empty: You have not asked for anything yet.
imports.productNameHint: The name, and the bike it is for, if you know it.

imports.photosNext: Next you can photograph the part. A picture tells us more than a part number, and a part number is often wrong or missing.

imports.nameNeeded: Tell us what the part is.
imports.linkNotValid: That does not look like a web link.
imports.quantityNotValid: Enter a whole number greater than zero.
imports.sent: Sent. We will get back to you.
imports.noPhotos: No photos were sent with this request.

account.title: Account
account.notificationsOn: Alerts are on for this device.
account.iosInstallFirst: On iPhone, add MotoParts to your home screen first — Safari cannot send alerts otherwise.
account.unverified: Your account is still being reviewed. You can browse, but not order yet.
account.verified: Your account is approved. Trade prices and orders are open to you.
account.signedOutBody: Sign in to see your trade prices and the orders you have asked for.
account.notificationsIntro: Get an alert on this device when we answer a request.
account.notificationsBlocked: This browser is blocking alerts and will not ask again. Turn them on for this site in your browser settings.
account.notificationsFailed: Alerts could not be turned on for this device.
account.installToGetAlerts: To get alerts on this iPhone, add MotoParts to your home screen first — Safari cannot send them otherwise.
account.alertsBlockedTitle: Alerts are blocked for this site. The browser will not ask again, so turn them on here:
account.iosStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari
account.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
account.iosStep4: Open MotoParts from your home screen and come back to this page
account.installStep1: Install MotoParts from your browser menu — look for "Install app" or "Add to Home screen"
account.installStep2: Open it from your home screen and come back to this page
account.blockedIosStep1: Open Settings, then Apps, then Safari
account.blockedIosStep2: Tap Notifications and allow them for this site
account.blockedIosStep3: Come back here and press the button again
account.blockedSafariStep1: In the menu bar: Safari → Settings → Websites → Notifications
account.blockedSafariStep2: Find this site, set it to Allow, then press the button again
account.blockedFirefoxStep1: Click the padlock in the address bar, then "Clear cookies and site data" or open Permissions
account.blockedFirefoxStep2: Set Notifications to Allow, reload, then press the button again
account.blockedChromeStep1: Click the padlock or the icon at the start of the address bar
account.blockedChromeStep2: Set Notifications to Allow, reload, then press the button again
account.alertsPromptBody: We will tell you the moment your order is answered, so you do not have to keep checking.

auth.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.

auth.awaitingReview: We will look at it and get back to you. You can sign in and browse in the meantime — ordering opens once your shop is approved.
